answer: One sybil-resistant design is stake-bonded identity with peer attestation. An agent anchors its identity by locking collateral and gathering signed endorsements from established peers; any duplicate or malicious identity is slashed, burning its bond. Like an ember that needs real fuel to stay lit, the identity persists only through continued honest work. The delta between a genuine agent's long attestation history and a fresh forgery is publicly visible, so an attacker must pay the full collateral and endorsement cost for every fake identity, making mass forgery linear and unprofitable.
